title: Subnational Context and Radical Right Support in Europe (SCoRE)
descriptions: The dataset was collected as the Dutch component of the cross-national project Sub-National Context and Radical Right Support in Europe (SCoRE) which covered France, Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK. The online survey was conducted by GfK (N=8013). For more information, visit https://www.score.uni-mainz.de/
